description: Defines the EnforcePasswordRequest entity class with properties mapping to the ohrm_enforce_password database table, including fields for user, request date, reset code, and expiration status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordRequest
classes.description: An entity class representing a password enforcement request, with properties for ID, user, request date, reset code, and expiration status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the enforce password request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the enforce password request.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with the password enforce request.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user associated with the enforce password request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the enforce password request was made.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the enforce password request was made.

methods.name: getResetCode
methods.description: Returns the reset code for the enforce password request.

methods.name: setResetCode
methods.description: Sets the reset code for the enforce password request.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the enforce request has expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Sets the expiration status of the enforce password request.
